drivingQuestion: From where is bringing near the meal-offering limited to men?
outcomeNote: the verse supplies the mishna's source

segments.he: הַגָּשׁוֹת. דִּכְתִיב: ״וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה... הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן״ – בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן, וְלֹא בְּנוֹת אַהֲרֹן.
segments.en: § With regard to «bringing near,» this is «as it is written: “And this is the law of the meal-offering: The sons of Aaron shall bring it near”» (Leviticus 6:7). This teaches that «the sons of Aaron» bring the meal-offering near, «but not the daughters of Aaron.»
